newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: John Keells shares up on foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: John Keells shares up on foreign buying.

text.p: John Keells Holdings Ltd rose 2.5 percent or 4.75 rupees to 195 rupees on foreign buying of 77,000 shares, brokers said.
"The share offers very good value at current levels, and it is cum bonus," said a local broker. The company declared a one for seven bonus on Friday.
The share more than doubled when the market last rallied in 1994. The blue chip John Keells is the holding company of Sri Lanka's largest and most diversified conglomerate.
